{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Ten, go to lasers, they must have lock-threat warning systems.|Corran Horn to Ooryl Qrygg|<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Lock-threat warning systems''' or '''Targeting lock warning systems''' provided [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] an indicator light when another [[Starship/Legends|ship]] obtains a [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] lock on theirs. By jinking sharply it was possible to break the lock before the torpedo was launched.<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron" />
